boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named campus stops for studying, meeting, making, viewing art, and moving between classes.

cards.title: Peter P. Mercer Learning Commons
cards.subtitle: George T. Potter Library and reservable study rooms
cards.notes: Reserve a group or media room through the library system, then check in promptly and leave the whiteboard clean for the next users.
cards.short_summary: A library-centered study stop with reservable rooms, media rooms, and individual study areas.
cards.evidence_claim: Potter Library in the Peter P. Mercer Learning Commons has study and media rooms for current Ramapo students; rooms include whiteboards and data/power outlets.
cards.source_title: Study Rooms: Reservations and Usage — George T. Potter Library
cards.access_notes: Study rooms are for current Ramapo students and require reservation/check-in; consult the library page for current room hours.

cards.title: Robert A. Scott Student Center
cards.subtitle: Dining, bookstore, and meeting rooms
cards.notes: Use the connected center as a practical meetup point before class; choose a meeting room or dining area that matches your group’s plan.
cards.short_summary: A connected campus hub with dining, bookstore, and meeting-room space.
cards.evidence_claim: The Robert A. Scott Student Center houses the college bookstore, dining areas, and numerous meeting rooms, and connects to the academic buildings.
cards.source_title: Academic Units — Office of Specialized Services
cards.access_notes: Use during building operating hours; individual rooms or services may have separate access rules.

cards.title: The Atrium Food Court
cards.subtitle: Student Center dining area
cards.notes: Make this a clear lunch-and-regroup stop in the Student Center, and check campus dining information before relying on a particular option.
cards.short_summary: The map-listed food-court destination inside the Student Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Ramapo’s campus map lists The Atrium (Food Court) among campus departments and offices.
cards.access_notes: Food purchases may be required; check current dining operations before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Berrie Center for Performing and Visual Arts
cards.title: Berrie Center for Performing and Visual Arts
cards.subtitle: Campus galleries and performance spaces
cards.notes: Check the Berrie Center calendar before going, then pair a scheduled show or gallery visit with time to look around the arts complex.
cards.short_summary: A map-listed performing and visual arts destination with accessible theater seating.
cards.evidence_claim: Ramapo identifies the Berrie Center for Performing and Visual Arts on its campus map and notes that it is wheelchair accessible with companion seating in Sharp Theater.
cards.source_title: Academic Units — Office of Specialized Services
cards.access_notes: Event, gallery, and building access vary by schedule; verify the relevant program before visiting.

cards.title: Kresge Gallery
cards.subtitle: Berrie Center gallery stop
cards.notes: Look for the gallery on the campus map, then check current arts listings before planning a viewing stop or bringing a visiting friend.
cards.short_summary: A named campus gallery destination within the arts area.
cards.evidence_claim: Ramapo’s campus map lists Kresge Gallery among its departments and offices.
cards.access_notes: Exhibitions and gallery access can vary; confirm the current schedule with the College.

cards.title: Pascal Gallery
cards.subtitle: Map-listed campus gallery
cards.notes: Use the campus map to find this gallery, and confirm the current exhibition or opening information before making it part of your route.
cards.short_summary: A second named gallery stop for an art-focused campus walk.
cards.evidence_claim: Ramapo’s campus map lists Pascal Gallery among its departments and offices.
cards.access_notes: Exhibition and access details are not stated on the map; verify with the College before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Bill Bradley Sports and Recreation Center
cards.title: Bill Bradley Sports and Recreation Center
cards.subtitle: Recreation and interscholastic athletics
cards.notes: Plan an active break around the center’s listed facilities, and ask Recreation or Athletics about current eligibility and open-use times.
cards.short_summary: A student-centered recreation building known as “The Bill.”
cards.evidence_claim: The Bill Bradley Sports and Recreation Center serves Ramapo’s recreational and interscholastic athletic needs and includes fitness, climbing, pool, gym, and multipurpose facilities.
cards.source_title: Sports & Recreation — Ramapo College Virtual Tour
cards.access_notes: Facility access and recreation hours may vary; confirm current policies before arriving.

cards.title: Sharp Fitness Center
cards.subtitle: Inside the Bill Bradley Sports and Recreation Center
cards.notes: Bring what you need for a short workout, then confirm current fitness-center access and equipment policies with campus recreation before heading over.
cards.short_summary: The named fitness facility within Ramapo’s recreation center.
cards.evidence_claim: Ramapo identifies the Sharp Fitness Center as a facility within the Bill Bradley Sports and Recreation Center.
cards.source_title: Sports & Recreation — Ramapo College Virtual Tour
cards.access_notes: Confirm current recreation-center entry rules and fitness-center hours before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Adele and Reuben Thomas Swimming Pool
cards.title: Adele and Reuben Thomas Swimming Pool
cards.subtitle: Bill Bradley Sports and Recreation Center
cards.notes: Check pool availability before you go, and follow the current recreation-center requirements for swim access and any needed equipment.
cards.short_summary: The named campus pool within the Bradley Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Ramapo identifies the Adele and Reuben Thomas Swimming Pool as one of the facilities in the Bill Bradley Sports and Recreation Center.
cards.source_title: Sports & Recreation — Ramapo College Virtual Tour
cards.access_notes: Pool hours, access, and programming may vary; verify current availability with campus recreation.

cards.title: Arch (Havemeyer)
cards.subtitle: Named campus landmark
cards.notes: Add this map-listed landmark to a walking loop between academic stops, and use the campus map to orient yourself before continuing across campus.
cards.short_summary: A named Havemeyer landmark that works as a clear visual waypoint.
cards.evidence_claim: Ramapo’s campus map lists Arch (Havemeyer) among campus buildings, and the College’s virtual tour includes an Arch campus area.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor landmark; use normal campus pedestrian routes and observe any posted restrictions.
